title: Pumpkin and Quinoa Patties
subtitle: with parsley, basil and nutmeg
description: Pan-fried patties of roasted pumpkin and quinoa with fresh herbs. Cooked rice or bulgur can replace the quinoa.

steps.text: Cook the quinoa in 2 cups of water for about 25 minutes until soft. Drain if any liquid remains.
Meanwhile, bake the pumpkin cubes in a covered dish for 15-20 minutes until soft. Let cool.
Fry the chopped onion in a non-stick pan with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and 1 tablespoon of canola oil for 3-5 minutes or until golden. Keep the pan for later.
Process the baked pumpkin with the fried onion, chopped herbs, garlic and egg in a food processor until a puree forms. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the quinoa, salt, pepper, nutmeg, breadcrumbs and flour and stir. Set aside for 5 minutes.
Heat a little oil in the non-stick pan. Shape the mixture into patties by hand and fry over medium heat for about 4 minutes until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towel.
